dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: We collect minimal information to provide our service:
dataCollection.email: Email address (for account recovery and notifications)
dataCollection.legalBasis: Legal basis: contract performance (providing the service you signed up for).

rights.title: Your Rights (GDPR)
rights.content: Under EU law, you have the following rights regarding your data:
rights.access: Right to access: request a copy of your data
rights.rectification: Right to rectification: correct inaccurate data
rights.deletion: Right to erasure: delete your account and all associated data
rights.portability: Right to portability: export your data in a standard format
rights.howTo: To exercise these rights, contact us at contact{'@'}constructionmap.org. We will respond within 30 days.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: We use the following external services:
thirdParty.google: Optional sign-in method. Shares your email and name with us.
thirdParty.cloudflare: Hosting and CDN. May process IP addresses.
thirdParty.aws: Email delivery. Processes email addresses for account emails.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.content: Your data is kept as long as your account exists. When you delete your account, all your personal data is permanently deleted within 30 days. Anonymized contribution data (overlays, projects) may be retained.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: We only use a session cookie to keep you logged in. This cookie is strictly necessary and does not require consent. We do not use any tracking, analytics, or advertising cookies.

userContent.title: User Content & Terms of Use
userContent.content: By uploading content to this website:

userContent.license: You grant us a non-exclusive license to display and distribute your content on this platform
userContent.moderation: We may remove content that violates our guidelines without notice
userContent.forbidden: Prohibited: illegal content, spam, copyrighted material without permission, offensive content
